checks.name: No promotional markup on any excluded service, quote, contact or booking page

Essential offer requires engagement and delay
Both CTAs use the controlled routes without a mini form
Click dismissal and seven-day suppression survive reload
Offer can reappear after suppression expires

Accurate recurring offer without artificial scarcity
Opening and dismissing the offer sends no lead or provider request
Mobile modal fits viewport and touch dismissal works
Service and Terms distinguish request, collection and HQC confirmation
CC01 service-specific deposits and legal links are explicit
Unverified landline WhatsApp link is removed

limits: Provider calls blocked; no booking, payment, CRM or customer communications
P14 analytics covered separately by analytics suite; P15 provider Booking Request completion unverified; P17 field performance unverified
Mobile viewport and touch emulation are not physical device certification
